title: Penguin's Heartlight

coreLoop: tap to guide the penguin horizontally
catch floating hearts and occasional golden hearts
each pair of catches visibly restores one aurora color band
change penguin scarf appearance at four and eight hearts
catch twelve hearts to restore the complete aurora
missed hearts disappear without penalty and new hearts continue to spawn
finish with a clear success state and celebratory audio
Award 10 points for a regular heart, 30 points for a visibly gold heart; only the separate hearts_collected counter advances the six aurora stages and 12-heart win.
fairness: the penguin catch area is generous and remains within the playfield
heart spawn and fall speed allow a reasonable reaction window
misses never consume lives or prevent eventual completion
all six aurora milestones are reachable in a normal play session
Bonus score must never trigger an aurora band, scarf unlock, or early victory without the required distinct heart-catch count.

reviewFocus: Check that the three scarf variants remain recognizably the same penguin as the source drawings.
Check that the player and heart sprites remain distinct on a snowy background.
Verify that every pair of catches reveals a new aurora band and updates the progress counter.
Verify that missing hearts never causes a softlock and that new hearts continue spawning.
Check tap responsiveness, forgiving collision radius, HUD overlap and readable result messaging on phone and tablet.

Screenshot acceptance: the penguin and scarf should remain legible without zoom on phone and tablet. Use a 1.5x visual-only IR render scale while retaining the authored 112 by 134 collider and horizontal control lane so avatar polish does not silently alter collision fairness.
Verify the tap-to-guide hint is visible beneath the objective on phone and tablet.

Use the three supplied penguin coloring-page images as visual reference inputs: preserve the shared round black-and-white penguin silhouette, large eyes, small beak, rosy cheeks, flippers, feet, and scarf across all variants.

Keep the three source-inspired variants distinguishable: rainbow patchwork scarf/body accents; festive multicolor head and scarf with cool-toned flippers; and classic black-and-white penguin with a blue striped scarf and warm orange feet.
Extract the penguin illustration only. Do not reproduce photographed paper borders, the coloring-page website watermark, handwritten names, or incidental pencil marks as game artwork.

Verify the penguin and collectible hearts remain visually distinct against the winter background at iPhone and iPad portrait and landscape sizes; retain before/after gameplay screenshots as review evidence.
Treat this as a portrait-only game: optimize portrait phone and tablet composition; landscape needs safe letterboxing and rotate guidance, not a redesigned playable layout.
Every missed heart must recycle and a single short tap must move the penguin along its fixed horizontal lane.
Verify aurora bands visibly brighten at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 hearts; a visibility toggle with zero alpha does not meet this requirement.
Preserve all three supplied scarf variants while keeping snowy scenery behind pickups and outside the instruction area.
Compare source-drawing scarf variants against before/mid/win images, and verify score can exceed twelve while progress remains twelve hearts.

Version 4 source-fidelity: verify real phone/tablet milestone screenshots show a multicolor striped crown and patchwork body for the rainbow penguin, purple/green/yellow/pink festive crown and blue flippers for holiday, and the classic dark crown with blue scarf. Reject a scarf-only skin swap even when game logic passes.

Run the PNG crown-color and transparency regression against the three canonical source-inspired sprites; preserve the 112×134 collider, one-tap controls, 1.5× visual scale and 4/8-heart transitions. No photographed paper, watermark, or handwritten labels may appear.

Version 5 screenshot acceptance: show the readable large intro panel for the first seven seconds, then remove the opaque story panel and title while preserving a short persistent tap hint, heart visibility, score, game progression and the 4/8 heart artwork variants. Restart must restore the intro without changing collision geometry.

Version 6 guided-play creative fix: preserve the initial readable story panel and seven-second timer as a fallback for hesitant players, but clear the opaque panel and large title immediately when the player catches the second heart / reveals the first aurora band. The small tap hint remains. Require real Chromium and WebKit iPhone/iPad first-reward screenshot evidence captured before seven seconds, while preserving identical touch controls, collision fairness, heart spawns, sprites, 4/8 scarf unlocks, and all six aurora stages. A guided run's rapid completion is not proof of a typical child's playtime; keep human pacing review open.
